snippet.title: Nature Hike - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Where will the trail lead you? Join your new friend Tendou on a hiking date and find out in this short and sweet fully voice-acted Visual Novel!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5095310/Nature_Hike/

You'd never have imagined yourself going on a day-long hiking date, much less with local tanuki hunk and recent friend Tendou Ishikawa! You had no idea he felt that way about you, and you barely knew you felt that way about him... but you're looking forward to finding out what awaits at the end of the journey.
